title: The WPSpeed plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting in versions up to, and including, 2.6.10…
description: The WPSpeed WordPress plugin versions up to and including 2.6.10 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability. This flaw arises from improper handling of entity-encoded markup in the LightImages HTML optimizer component, allowing authenticated users with Subscriber-level access or higher to inject malicious scripts via their profile display name. When a logged-out visitor views the attacker's author archive page, the injected script executes.
